# Scriptia Solutions
> Scripts for explainer, product and training videos, written to time. A small script-writing studio in Leeds, West Yorkshire, England.

Scriptia Solutions writes scripts for explainer videos, product demos and short training films at a fixed price per finished minute. Each script is timed aloud, delivered with a shot column and includes two rounds of changes. It does not film, edit, animate, cast voice-over or place adverts.

- [Explainer scripts](https://scriptiasolutions.com/explainer-scripts.html): £240 up to 90 seconds, £420 up to 3 minutes
- [Product demo scripts](https://scriptiasolutions.com/product-demo-scripts.html): £150 per minute
- [Training film scripts](https://scriptiasolutions.com/training-film-scripts.html): £130 per minute
- [How we write](https://scriptiasolutions.com/how-we-write.html)
- [Fees and cancellations](https://scriptiasolutions.com/fees-and-cancellations.html)
- [Commission a script](https://scriptiasolutions.com/commission-a-script.html)
